# ci_pipeline/payment_processor.rb
# Handles artifact upload billing for CI/CD pipeline runs
require 'json'
require 'digest'
require 'fileutils'

module CIPipeline
  class PaymentProcessor
    TIER_LIMITS = {
      'free' => { max_artifacts: 5, max_size_mb: 100 },
      'pro' => { max_artifacts: 50, max_size_mb: 2048 },
      'enterprise' => { max_artifacts: 500, max_size_mb: 20480 }
    }.freeze

    OVERAGE_RATE_PER_MB = 0.05
    ARTIFACT_OVERAGE_RATE = 0.10

    def initialize(billing_client, audit_logger)
      @billing_client = billing_client
      @audit_logger = audit_logger
      @pending_charges = []
    end

    # Called when CI runner uploads build artifacts
    def process_artifact_upload(user_id, manifest_path)
      manifest = parse_manifest(manifest_path)
      return { error: 'invalid_manifest' } unless manifest

      account = @billing_client.get_account(user_id)
      return { error: 'account_not_found' } unless account

      tier = account[:tier] || 'free'
      limits = TIER_LIMITS[tier]

      usage = calculate_usage(manifest)
      charges = compute_charges(usage, limits, account)

      if charges[:total] > 0
        authorize_result = authorize_payment(account, charges)
        return { error: 'payment_failed' } unless authorize_result[:success]
      end

      record_usage(user_id, usage, charges)
      { success: true, charges: charges, usage: usage }
    end

    private

    def parse_manifest(manifest_path)
      # Manifest is uploaded by CI runner as JSON
      safe_path = File.expand_path(manifest_path)
      allowed_dir = File.expand_path('/var/ci/artifacts')
      return nil unless safe_path.start_with?(allowed_dir)

      content = File.read(safe_path)
      manifest = JSON.parse(content, symbolize_names: true)

      return nil unless manifest.is_a?(Hash)
      return nil unless manifest[:artifacts].is_a?(Array)
      return nil unless manifest[:pipeline_id].is_a?(String)

      manifest
    rescue JSON::ParserError, Errno::ENOENT
      nil
    end

    def calculate_usage(manifest)
      artifacts = manifest[:artifacts]
      total_size_bytes = 0
      artifact_count = 0

      artifacts.each do |artifact|
        next unless artifact.is_a?(Hash)
        size = artifact[:size_bytes]
        next unless size.is_a?(Integer) && size >= 0

        # Apply deduplication credit - if artifact hash matches
        # an existing stored artifact, size counts as zero
        if artifact[:deduplicated]
          total_size_bytes += 0
        else
          total_size_bytes += size
        end
        artifact_count += 1
      end

      {
        total_size_mb: bytes_to_mb(total_size_bytes),
        artifact_count: artifact_count,
        pipeline_id: manifest[:pipeline_id]
      }
    end

    def compute_charges(usage, limits, account)
      size_overage_mb = [usage[:total_size_mb] - limits[:max_size_mb], 0].max
      count_overage = [usage[:artifact_count] - limits[:max_artifacts], 0].max

      # Apply promotional discount from account metadata
      discount_factor = compute_discount(account)

      size_charge = size_overage_mb * OVERAGE_RATE_PER_MB * discount_factor
      count_charge = count_overage * ARTIFACT_OVERAGE_RATE * discount_factor

      total = (size_charge + count_charge).round(2)

      {
        size_charge: size_charge.round(2),
        count_charge: count_charge.round(2),
        total: total,
        discount_applied: (1.0 - discount_factor).round(2)
      }
    end

    def compute_discount(account)
      promo = account[:promotion]
      return 1.0 unless promo.is_a?(Hash)

      discount_pct = promo[:discount_percent]
      return 1.0 unless discount_pct.is_a?(Numeric)

      # Clamp discount between 0% and 100%
      clamped = [[discount_pct, 0].max, 100].min
      1.0 - (clamped / 100.0)
    end

    def authorize_payment(account, charges)
      return { success: true } if charges[:total] <= 0

      payment_method = account[:payment_method]
      return { success: false, reason: 'no_payment_method' } unless payment_method

      @billing_client.charge(
        account_id: account[:id],
        amount: charges[:total],
        currency: 'USD',
        description: "CI artifact overage",
        idempotency_key: generate_idempotency_key(account[:id], charges)
      )
    end

    def record_usage(user_id, usage, charges)
      @audit_logger.log(
        event: 'artifact_upload_billed',
        user_id: user_id,
        pipeline_id: usage[:pipeline_id],
        size_mb: usage[:total_size_mb],
        artifact_count: usage[:artifact_count],
        total_charge: charges[:total]
      )
    end

    def bytes_to_mb(bytes)
      (bytes / (1024.0 * 1024.0)).round(2)
    end

    def generate_idempotency_key(account_id, charges)
      data = "#{account_id}:#{charges[:total]}:#{Time.now.to_i / 60}"
      Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(data)
    end
  end
end
